401-3944-6273-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-6273-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

2493-4113-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by tapping Archaeomancer due to Essence Flux's convoke ability, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

116-822-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
116-822-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Roar of the Kha without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Roar of the Kha, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

1479-2841-2907-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-2907-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5231-5961--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Repeat.

774-3861-5478.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting  Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers.
Activate Orzhov Basilicaby tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Orzhov Basilica's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3778-7299.description:
Cast Austere Command by paying its mana cost, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
3778-7299.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater.

1636-2034-5803-7244.description:
Cast Soul Summons by paying its mana cost.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Soul Summons.
Resolve the copy of Soul Summons, causing you to put a card from your library onto the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the face-down creature, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3

2781-3817-3967.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1876-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
1876-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Worldwaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

147-5256-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

465-803-3742-4251-6965.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3041-4090.description:
Deal damage to Coalhauler Swine.
Coalhauler Swine triggers, dealing that much damage to each player. Any damage that would be dealt to you is instead dealt to Coalhauler Swine due to Pariah.
Repeat step 2.

4316-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat

3430-4499-5954-6664.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2034-2882-6603.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2034-2882-6603.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-2882-6603.description:
Cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial due to Infinite Reflection.
When the creature enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial.
Repeat from step 2.

325-602-1742-6282.easyPrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
325-602-1742-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Toluz's second ability and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Toluz trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Repeat.

803-907-1399-1606.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

855-1491-4289-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
855-1491-4289-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
855-1491-4289-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

141-3645-5686.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

527-997-5140.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-997-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-997-5140.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Selvala, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-997-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

215-1902-2905.notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five Elves.
215-1902-2905.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Pestermite to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Pestermite by paying {2}{U}.
When Pestermite enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Elves, this combo nets infinite mana.

2115-2592-2615.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Offspring's Revenge triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a 1/1 copy of it with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Electropotence triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Electropotence trigger, causing you to pay {2}{R} to have the Tree of Perdition token deal damage equal to its power to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or les life.

122-372-1496-4050.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Abdel Adrian's toughness.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to the Soldier's toughness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Abdel Adrian, adding one mana of any color.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Phyrexian Delver to return to the battlefield from exile.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose five life.
Repeat from step 2.

1182-1661-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Stonecoil Serpent on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2732-4050-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other nontoken creatures.
2732-4050-4499.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four other nontoken creatures, adding four mana of any color(s).
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers four times, exiling the sacrificed creatures from your graveyard.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Prowling Geistcatcher.
Prowling Geistcatcher leaves the battlefield, returning all creature cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

654-2713-4257-4499.description:
Activate Emiel, exiling Golos and returning Golos to the battlefield.
Golos triggers, searching your library for a land and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Repeat.

2058-2073-4659.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Flayer Husk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Flayer Husk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Flayer Husk to it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Flayer Husk, adding {C}{C}.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.
